theme: Xử lý khi khách từ chối

vocab.meaning_vi: đưa ra ý kiến phản đối
vocab.example: The client raised an objection about the contract length.
vocab.example_vi: Khách hàng đưa ra ý kiến phản đối về thời hạn hợp đồng.

vocab.example: Listening carefully helps you overcome an objection.
vocab.example_vi: Lắng nghe kỹ giúp bạn vượt qua sự phản đối của khách.

vocab.example: I could sense some hesitation in his voice.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi có thể cảm nhận sự do dự trong giọng nói của anh ấy.

vocab.example: Our support plan gives customers real peace of mind.
vocab.example_vi: Gói hỗ trợ của chúng tôi mang lại sự an tâm thực sự cho khách hàng.

vocab.example: Small companies often show high price sensitivity.
vocab.example_vi: Các công ty nhỏ thường có độ nhạy cảm về giá cao.

vocab.example: Asking about payment is a strong buying signal.
vocab.example_vi: Hỏi về thanh toán là một tín hiệu mua hàng mạnh mẽ.

vocab.example: That's a common misconception about our pricing.
vocab.example_vi: Đó là một hiểu lầm phổ biến về giá cả của chúng tôi.

vocab.example: Trust-building matters more than a quick sale.
vocab.example_vi: Xây dựng lòng tin quan trọng hơn việc bán hàng nhanh chóng.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Honestly, I have to raise an objection about the contract length.

lines.speaker: Trang
lines.text: I understand. What's causing your hesitation exactly?

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: We're worried about being locked in for two years.

lines.speaker: Trang
lines.text: That's a common misconception. You can actually cancel anytime after six months.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Oh, that gives me some peace of mind.

lines.speaker: Trang
lines.text: Great, I can see that's a buying signal. Should we prepare the paperwork?

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: Not so fast. I still have concerns about price sensitivity in our budget.

lines.speaker: Trang
lines.text: I understand price sensitivity is a real concern. Let's look at a flexible payment plan.

lines.speaker: Khoa
lines.text: That could work. How do you usually overcome an objection like this?

lines.speaker: Trang
lines.text: By listening carefully and focusing on trust-building before pushing for a decision.

questions.q: What is Khoa's first objection about?
What does Trang say is a common misconception?
options: Being locked in for two years

questions.q: What does Trang focus on to overcome objections?

shadowing: I have to raise an objection about the length of this contract.
That's actually a common misconception many clients have about our terms.
Knowing the details gives me a lot of peace of mind.
We understand your price sensitivity, so let's find a flexible plan.
Trust-building is the best way to overcome a customer's objection.
